title: The Death of Demographics: Why Generational Intelligence is the Future of Business Strategy
abstract: Diaz argues demographic targeting (age/generation bands) is a poor proxy for what drives behavior, and proposes 'generational intelligence' — behavior predicted by 'consciousness evolution' rather than birth year — as a replacement. Reports analyzing '100 major global founders across 80 years of commercial history' to find a 'PAIN → PURPOSE → Business Innovation' pattern claimed at 92.5% prediction accuracy, used to explain the rise of Netflix, TikTok, and Amazon. Self-reported findings; no methodology, dataset, or peer review is published alongside the claim.
